## 043 planner-schema-decomposition
- [043] @planner-aggregate @foreign-keys @app-sweep — planner_id is the shared PK across aggregate + projection tables with NO FKs among them; FKs point only outward to users or the write-once planner core; deletion is an app-side batch sweep. REJECTED: FK cascade among aggregate tables — an FK-child's shared lock is the upsert deadlock, and cascade couples deletion to the DB engine. → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D1)
- [043] @planner_content @deadlock @optimistic-lock — the owner hot path writes ONLY planner_content and no table FK-references it. REJECTED: owner-mutated columns on an FK-referenced row (a same-tx child insert's S lock upgrades to X and deadlocks two racers; spike SP1 80/80) and @DynamicUpdate/index-drops (SP1 left them at 80/80). → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D2)
- [043] @planner_stats @counters — all counters live only in planner_stats, authoritative outright. REJECTED: dual-write + updatable=false guard + stats.reads-enabled flag — a stop-the-world migration removes the transitional state. → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D3)
- [043] @planner_catalog @sort @fulltext — visible-only projection (membership == published ∧ ¬deleted ∧ ¬taken_down), recency-only sort on first_published_at, ngram FULLTEXT title. REJECTED: a mirror projection with published/deleted/taken_down columns — visibility as row-presence collapses the index shape. → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D4)
- [043] @planner_entity_filter @planner_keyword_filter @inverted-index — integer entity facets and string keyword facets in two inverted tables with reverse indexes, FK to the write-once core. REJECTED: one polymorphic VARCHAR filter table (taxes the big integer index for the small keyword set) and a set-column keyword filter (non-indexable). → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D5)
- [043] @title-search @fulltext @ngram — MySQL ngram FULLTEXT (token size 2) with backend-built boolean query, operators escaped, OR'd against a keyword-index EXISTS. REJECTED: the default word parser (cannot tokenize CJK), a suffix table (over-engineering), LIKE/FIND_IN_SET (non-sargable). → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D6)
- [043] @selected_keywords @keyword-converter — selected_keywords becomes a display-only JSON array; filtering moves to the keyword index; clean-at-rest. REJECTED: MySQL SET (ALTER-per-keyword, non-indexable), TEXT (chosen JSON for consistency with content), VARCHAR (length recompute per keyword). → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D7)
- [043] @projection-maintenance @async @read-your-writes — the cheap catalog scalar copy is synchronous in the write txn; the expensive filter rebuild is an AFTER_COMMIT (REQUIRES_NEW) event, skipped when composition is unchanged. - [043] @publish @api — publish is a single content-carrying request (upload-then-toggle atomically); unpublish stays a lightweight toggle. REJECTED: two sequential cross-region round-trips for one user action. → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D9)
- [043] @recommended @planner_catalog @planner_stats — recommended is a derived catalog flag for the list; moderation source/audit kept. REJECTED: the flag on planner_stats (hot-write table must not carry a queried index) or on planner_publication (the vote path must not write publication). → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D10)
- [043] @reconciler @drift — a scheduled reconciler validates stats, comment counts, catalog membership, both filter tables, and the recommended flag; it emits structured drift records and never auto-repairs. - [043] @planner_moderation @foreign-key — hidden_by_moderator_id FK → users ON DELETE SET NULL; NULL plus hidden_at means moderator deleted. REJECTED: sentinel-0 reassignment — NULL loses no information here. → docs/tasks/043-planner-schema-decomposition/spec.md (D12)

- [043] @planner_catalog @planner_type @index — the browse index leads with the sort key (first_published_at) keeping planner_type/category as in-index residuals; the recommended index leads with the selective flag.
